summary.description: The review verdict in prose: what was checked, how, and the overall call. Becomes the review body. For a question rather than a review, the answer.

path.description: Repository-relative path of the file the finding anchors to.

line.description: Line number in the version named by side. Must be a line the diff shows.

startLine.description: First line of a multi-line span, or null for a single line.

side.description: RIGHT for the new version of the file, LEFT only for a deleted line.

body.description: One issue: the claim, why it matters, the evidence, and the concrete fix. Markdown.

unverified.description: Claims that needed a command the handler declined or that could not be run. Each stays a question, not a finding.

reason.description: Why it stayed unverified: the handler's decline reason, or what went wrong.
